messages:
maya (VP People): Thanks everyone for coming to the all-hands. Quick follow-up thread on hiring & org mapping questions we promised to clarify. I'll drop the high-level bullets then take Qs.

sam (CTO): Key context: we're prioritizing throughput/latency work for H1, then platform reliability in H2. That influences where headcount lands (serving runtime + infra).

maya (VP People): TL;DR: we have 28 net new roles approved for FY; hiring will be staged across three sprints (Q2 hiring burst, steady Q3, reserve hires for Q4). We plan explicit blocks for Dedicated & Private product expertise.

jordan (eng-manager): Do we have visibility into which teams get the Q2 burst? trying to plan manager capacity & interviews.

maya (VP People): Q2 burst focus: 10 roles to eng-runtime (mixed seniority), 6 to eng-infra/eng-sre, 4 to devex/docs, 4 to product/solutions. The remaining 4 are flexible reserves for high-priority customer-facing needs.

alex (product): For product roles, is that PM + PO mix or more biz-ops? we need to know for recruiting brief.

maya (VP People): Product allocation is 2 PMs (platform), 1 PM for Dedicated, 1 for Partner integrations. Recruit briefs coming tomorrow from Lisa.

lisa (People Ops): I'll post the requisition templates + interview rubrics in #recruiting in 30m. Please flag any role-specific must-haves ASAP.

nina (IC): How does this affect the recent org map changes mentioned on slide 8 — are teams getting merged or is it just reporting lines?

omar (platform-eng): Also curious about oncall load. If runtime hires are prioritized, does that shift oncall rotations?

sam (CTO): Good Qs. Org map changes are mostly consolidation of shared infra services under Eng-Platform (no mass layoffs). A few small teams will move under a single manager to reduce manager-to-IC ratio.

sam (CTO): Oncall: short-term we will keep rotations the same. New hires will be onboarded into a shadow rotation model; longer term we will re-evaluate pager load and hire SRE-focused headcount if metrics (MTTR, page volume) don't improve.

maya (VP People): To be explicit: no involuntary role eliminations tied to this hiring plan. It's restructuring to improve span-of-control and remove duplicate project orgs.

jordan (eng-manager): For the consolidation, can we get a map of affected teams & direct reports? even a CSV would help for 1:1 conversations.

maya (VP People): Yes — we'll publish a 'team-mapping playbook' doc with before/after reporting lines and suggested talking points for managers by EOD Thursday.

alex (product): Are IC career ladders impacted? will promotion cycles shift because of the reorg?

maya (VP People): Promotion cycles stay the same timeline. We're updating role families to reflect cross-team expectations; managers should continue regular calibration. We'll run an optional calibration workshop next week.

nina (IC): Hiring speed question — what's the SLA from req to offer for the Q2 burst? we often see long tails.

lisa (People Ops): Goal is 6–8 weeks for senior ICs, 4–6 weeks for mid/junior. We'll re-prioritize recruiters to the Q2 buckets. If teams have interview stage friction, please ping me with stage IDs.

omar (platform-eng): Can we get clarity on candidate profiles for runtime roles? e.g., quantized inference, CUDA/TFX experience vs system design emphasis.

sam (CTO): Runtime hires: strong systems + model-serving experience preferred. We're not blocking on specific vendor stack — quantization/LLM infra experience is a plus but we can train for framework specifics.

maya (VP People): Next steps: Lisa will share reqs + rubrics, Sam and I will host an optional 30m Q&A Friday 10am for managers about messaging and hiring prioritization. If you need the before/after team map sooner, DM me.

harper (allhands-bot): :calendar: Event created: "Hiring sprint Q&A" Fri 10:00 — attendees: maya, sam, lisa.

jordan (eng-manager): Thanks — pinging folks to review rubrics when posted.

nina (IC): Appreciate the transparency. small ask: can we get a public doc that lists open reqs + stage (screening/onsite/offer) so we can see pipeline?

lisa (People Ops): We'll share a read-only tracker for internal visibility (no candidate PII). Expect link in #recruiting tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maya (VP People): Thanks all. If anyone has sensitive concerns about staffing changes, escalate to me or Lisa directly — we want to handle manager transitions carefully.

sam (CTO): thx — real focus is to keep product delivery predictable while we scale hiring and reduce bus factor.

alex (product): One last note — product will prioritize clear acceptance criteria for new platform features to make interviews easier (samples of past PRDs). I'll coordinate with devex.

maya (VP People): Closing note: we're committed to a phased approach; expect tighter coordination between hiring, onboarding, and eng ops. More to follow. :sparkles:
